rules.statement: The plaintiff-respondent's right to purchase the defendant-appellant's one-third share in 'Ralston House' was extinguished by the Abolition of Fideicommissum and Entails Act No. 20 of 1972, which vested the defendant-appellant with an absolute title to that share.
rules.supporting_quote: "By Section 4 of-this Act, the defendant-appellant became vested with an absolute title to the said 1/3 share. By operation of law, she became vested with full and complete ownership and her fiduciary right or interest ceased to exist."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 4 of Abolition of Fidei commissa and Entails Act No. 20 of 1972
